programs.name: subfilt
programs.purpose: Apply a Butterworth low-cut, high-cut, or bandpass filter to each trace.

params.name: dt
params.description: Sample interval in seconds; required when the header value is zero.

params.name: zerophase
params.description: Apply the filter forward and backward.

params.name: npoleslo
params.default: computed: bfdesign from low-cut frequencies and amplitudes
params.description: Explicit low-cut pole count; the selfdoc misspells this as npoleselo.

params.name: npoleshi
params.default: computed: bfdesign from high-cut frequencies and amplitudes
params.description: Explicit high-cut pole count; the selfdoc misspells this as npolesehi.

params.name: f3dblo
params.default: computed: bfdesign, or 0.15 * Nyquist when npoleslo is supplied
params.description: Low-cut 3 dB frequency; read only when npoleslo is supplied.

params.name: f3dbhi
params.default: computed: bfdesign, or 0.40 * Nyquist when npoleshi is supplied
params.description: High-cut 3 dB frequency; read only when npoleshi is supplied.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Recursive Butterworth sections, filter design and square roots depend on floating-point order and math-library behavior; zero-phase mode reverses and filters twice.
programs.difficulty_reason: Butterworth design and recursive filtering require numerical library behavior to be reproduced.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | subfilt
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | subfilt zerophase=0 hicut=0 npoleslo=3 f3dblo=15

programs.license_note: Credits identify SEAM Project contributor Bruce Verwest and the adapted subfiltpole option.

programs.name: succfilt
programs.purpose: Filter gather spectra according to adjacent-trace phase correlation.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUCCFILT -  FX domain Correlation Coefficient FILTER
programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT results and atan2/cos phase comparisons can vary near thresholds. The last trace and Nyquist bin are not correlation-filtered.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers gathers and applies per-frequency FFT filtering.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sushw key=ntr a=8 | succfilt key=ep ccl=0.3 cch=1 padd=25
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sushw key=ntr a=8 | succfilt key=ep ccl=-0.2 cch=0.8 padd=50

programs.license_note: Credits identify Potash Corporation and Balazs Nemeth.

programs.name: sudeghost
programs.purpose: Apply a frequency-domain ghosting or deghosting filter to each trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDEGHOST - applies a DEGHOSTING filter in (t,x) or (tau,p) data

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: seismic tr.dt / 1000000, otherwise tr.d1; 0.004 if zero and unspecified
params.description: Sample interval; consulted only when the header-derived interval is zero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT, complex division and trigonometric functions affect rounding; the first slowness is computed as f2+d2, and invalid slowness can cause a square root of a negative value.
programs.difficulty_reason: The trace-dependent complex filter and FFT require numerical care.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sudeghost h=10 r=0.5

test_cases.description: Model ghosts without the obliquity factor.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sudeghost h=12 v=1500 r=0.4 deghost=0 lambert=0 pnoise=0.00001

programs.name: sudipfilt
programs.purpose: Filter trace panels by slope in the frequency-wavenumber domain.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDIPFILT - DIP--or better--SLOPE Filter in f-k domain

params.name: dt
params.description: Sample interval; required if the header value is zero.

params.name: dx
params.description: Trace spacing; required if neither alias nor header supplies a nonzero value.

params.name: d2
params.description: Alias for dx, consulted only when dx is absent.

params.name: bias
params.description: Slope shifted to horizontal during filtering.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR if set, otherwise empty

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Two-dimensional FFT, interpolated slope amplitudes and complex phase shifts depend on operation order and transcendental functions.
programs.difficulty_reason: The implementation buffers an entire panel and performs a two-dimensional FFT with slope interpolation.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sudipfilt dx=10
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sudipfilt dx=10 slopes=-0.002,-0.001,0.001,0.002 amps=0,1,1,0 bias=0.0005

programs.name: sufilter
programs.purpose: Apply a zero-phase polygonal frequency filter with sine-squared tapers.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFILTER - applies a zero-phase, sine-squared tapered filter

params.name: amps
params.default: computed: 0 at endpoints and 1 at interior f values

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: seismic tr.dt / 1000000, otherwise tr.d1; 0.004 if zero and unspecified
params.description: Sample interval; consulted only when the header-derived interval is zero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT rounding, frequency-bin rounding and sine-squared taper evaluation affect exact results.
programs.difficulty_reason: The filter constructs a polygonal frequency response and applies FFTs.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sufilter
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sufilter f=10,20,30,40 amps=1,0,0,1

programs.name: sufrac
programs.purpose: Apply a fractional time derivative or integral and phase shift in the frequency domain.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUFRAC -- take general (fractional) time derivative or integral of

params.name: sign
params.description: Sign of the imaginary frequency factor.

params.name: phasefac
params.description: Additional phase in multiples of pi.

params.name: dt
params.description: Documented in selfdoc but never read from arguments; a zero header-derived interval causes an error.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT, complex exponential and pow are platform-sensitive; negative powers use FLT_MAX at zero frequency.
programs.difficulty_reason: The operation uses FFTs and complex fractional powers.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sufrac power=0.5 sign=1
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sufrac power=-1 phasefac=0.25

programs.name: sufwatrim
programs.purpose: Produce one frequency-domain alpha-trimmed trace per gather.

params.name: key
params.description: Mixing-coordinate header names; documented as required, but absence is not explicitly rejected.

params.name: vf
params.description: Read but not used; selfdoc says 0.

params.name: fac
params.description: Clamped to at least 1, but otherwise unused.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sorting, weighted summation and FFT order affect results. Computed distance weights are overwritten with 1; the trim percentage is fixed at 15. The first trace is used if no mark is set.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers gathers, sorts frequency components and performs FFTs.

test_cases.description: Trim a gather using trace number as coordinate.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sushw key=ntr a=8 | sufwatrim key=tracl dx=1 keyg=ep

test_cases.description: Use a marked output trace and extra padding.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sushw key=ntr a=8 | sushw key=mark a=1 | sufwatrim key=tracl dx=2 padd=50 vf=0

programs.name: suk1k2filter
programs.purpose: Apply separable polygonal filters to the two spatial wavenumber axes.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUK1K2FILTER - symmetric box-like K-domain filter defined by the

params.name: amps1
params.default: computed: 0 at endpoints and 1 at interior k1 values

params.name: amps2
params.default: computed: 0 at endpoints and 1 at interior k2 values

params.name: quad
params.description: Select all or a pair of quadrants.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR if set, otherwise empty

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Two-dimensional FFT, bin rounding and sine-squared taper calculations affect exact results.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers a panel and constructs separable filters for a two-dimensional FFT.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | suk1k2filter d1=1 d2=1

test_cases.description: Select a quadrant pair with custom filters.

programs.name: sukfilter
programs.purpose: Apply a radially symmetric polygonal wavenumber filter to a trace panel.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUKFILTER - radially symmetric K-domain, sin^2-tapered, polygonal

params.name: amps
params.default: computed: 0 at endpoints and 1 at interior k values

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The radial grid, FFT and sine taper use floating-point math; the code rounds sqrt(d1²+d2²) to an integer before computing Nyquist, unlike the selfdoc.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers a panel and maps a radial filter onto a two-dimensional FFT grid.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sukfilter d1=1 d2=1
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sukfilter d1=1 d2=1 k=0,0.05,0.15,0.25 amps=1,1,0,0 verbose=0

programs.name: sukfrac
programs.purpose: Apply a radial or directional fractional wavenumber derivative and phase shift.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUKFRAC - apply FRACtional powers of i|k| to data, with phase shift

params.name: phasefac
params.description: Additional phase in multiples of pi.

params.name: angle
params.description: When supplied, enable a directional operator at this angle in degrees.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT, pow, square roots, trigonometric functions and complex exponential affect exact output, especially at zero wavenumber for negative powers.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers a panel and applies complex fractional powers to a two-dimensional FFT.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sukfrac d1=1 d2=1 power=0.5 phasefac=-0.25
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sukfrac d1=1 d2=1 power=1 angle=45 sign=-1

programs.name: sulfaf
programs.purpose: Mix nearby traces in the frequency domain to form a low-frequency array response.

params.name: maxmix
params.default: computed: -1 initially, replaced by first gather's ntr

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT and trace-mixing accumulation order affect rounding; maxmix defaults to the first gather size and remains fixed for subsequent gathers.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers gathers and performs frequency-dependent trace mixing and FFTs.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sushw key=ntr a=8 | sulfaf key=ep
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sushw key=ntr a=8 | sulfaf key=ep f1=5 f2=30 fr=3 vel=1200 dx=10 maxmix=5 tri=1 adb=0.5

programs.name: sumedian
programs.purpose: Align traces along a supplied moveout curve, mix or median-filter them, and optionally subtract the result.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMEDIAN - MEDIAN filter about a user-defined polygonal curve with

params.name: xshift
params.description: Curve positions; required with tshift unless both input files are supplied.

params.name: tshift
params.description: Curve times; required with xshift unless both input files are supplied.

params.name: nshift
params.description: Number of values in each input file; required when both files are supplied.

params.name: xfile
params.description: Binary float positions file, paired with tfile.

params.name: tfile
params.description: Binary float times file, paired with xfile.

params.name: median
params.description: Use median instead of weighted mixing.

params.name: nmed
params.default: 5 when median is nonzero; otherwise uninitialized and unused
params.description: Median window length; even values are incremented.

params.name: subtract
params.description: Subtract filtered data from the input.

params.name: tmpdir
params.default: computed: CWP_TMPDIR if set, otherwise empty

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Interpolation, weighted accumulation and median sorting affect rounding; edge handling and integer-rounded shifts are significant.
programs.difficulty_reason: The implementation buffers traces, interpolates a moveout curve and supports weighted and median windows.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sumedian xshift=1,16 tshift=0,0.04 mix=0.5,1,0.5
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | sumedian xshift=1,16 tshift=0,0.04 median=1 nmed=5 sign=1 subtract=0

programs.name: suminphase
programs.purpose: Convert each input trace to a minimum-phase signal by spectral factorization.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUMINPHASE - convert input to minimum phase

params.name: sign1
params.description: First FFT sign, normalized to plus or minus one.

params.name: sign2
params.description: Second FFT sign, normalized to plus or minus one.

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: seismic tr.dt / 1000000, otherwise tr.d1; 0.004 if zero and unspecified
params.description: Consulted only when the header-derived interval is zero.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Complex FFT, logarithm and exponential are sensitive to rounding and platform math; an all-zero trace divides by zero when normalizing by its maximum.
programs.difficulty_reason: Homomorphic spectral factorization uses several complex FFTs and transcendental operations.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | suminphase

test_cases.description: Alternate transform signs and noise floor.
test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | suminphase sign1=-1 sign2=1 pnoise=0.0001

programs.license_note: The internal spectral-factorization routine credits Bruce VerWest, 2009.

programs.name: suphase
programs.purpose: Transform each trace's phase spectrum using a linear formula.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUPHASE - PHASE manipulation by linear transformation

params.name: a
params.description: Constant phase shift in degrees; selfdoc says 90.

params.name: b
params.description: Multiplier converted from degrees to radians.

params.name: dt
params.description: Sample interval; read but not used in the phase calculation.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT, atan2, square root, sine and cosine affect exact values; c multiplies the bin index rather than frequency in hertz.
programs.difficulty_reason: The phase manipulation requires FFTs and transcendental functions.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | suphase
suplane nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | suphase a=90 b=90 c=0.01

programs.name: susmgauss2
programs.purpose: Smooth a two-dimensional trace panel with a Gaussian wavenumber filter.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUSMGAUSS2 --- SMOOTH a uniformly sampled 2d array of velocities
programs.float_sensitive_notes: Two-dimensional FFT, exp and pow affect rounding; output is scaled by the ratio of input and filtered maxima, which can divide by zero. Despite the selfdoc, the code does not convert velocity to slowness.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program buffers the panel, performs a two-dimensional FFT and rescales by extrema.

test_cases.command: suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | susmgauss2 a1=2 a2=3
suplane nt=128 ntr=16 dt=0.004 | susmgauss2 a1=0 a2=4

programs.name: sutvband
programs.purpose: Apply a time-varying bandpass by interpolating between separately filtered trace segments.

params.name: dt
params.description: Sample interval; required when the header value is zero.

params.name: f
params.description: Repeat one four-frequency array for each tf value.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: FFT, sine tapers, time-to-sample rounding and interpolation order affect exact results; duplicate or out-of-range filter times can cause division by zero or invalid indexing.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program builds multiple frequency filters and interpolates between FFT-filtered segments.
